result.question: What did the old prophet say about the man of God?

readings.answer: That he had disobeyed the LORD’s command, so the LORD delivered him to a lion which mauled and killed him, according to the LORD’s word.
readings.support: It is the man of God who disobeyed the command of the LORD. Therefore the LORD has delivered him to the lion, and it has mauled him and killed him, according to the word that the LORD had spoken to him

assessments.reason: It quotes the prophet’s statement that the man of God disobeyed the LORD’s command and even includes the supported additional details from verse 26; this directly matches the key’s core point.

result.reason: Verse 26 explicitly says the prophet declared the man of God had disobeyed the LORD’s command.
